info.title: API-DocTest-List Support Tickets Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status Retrieval API enables users to easily access the current statuses of their support tickets. This endpoint returns a comprehensive list of ticket statuses, allowing consumers to monitor ongoing support requests effectively. Typical users include support staff and customers who require real-time updates on their support inquiries. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their customer service management and ensure timely responses to user concerns.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of tickets, providing insights into their progress and any updates. It's useful for monitoring and managing ticket lifecycles effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of tickets. Ensure that all required parameters are provided in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current ticket status.

ListSupportTicketsStatusRequest.description: A status value for tickets, represented as a string.
